issue.title: test_tracked_marker_path_passing_sites_are_reviewed fails: finalizers/cli.py:_target_for_dir and run_agent_directive_metadata.py:session_root_tab are unreviewed

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Found by the sase-1bn land agent while triaging the failures listed on sase-1bn note #2 (sase-1bf.land) and sase-1bn.7 note #2. Deterministic, not a flake: it fails identically at the pre-sase-1bn base b9cfa7386 and at master 52f7351ae (serial `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_path_passing_audit.py -o addopts=""`).

The static audit reports two tracked marker-path passing sites missing from the reviewed allowlist:

- `src/sase/finalizers/cli.py:_target_for_dir` — added by a0b25eea5 (sase-1b2.13, "sase final status run view"); epic sase-1b2 is closed, so this half has no owner.
- `src/sase/axe/run_agent_directive_metadata.py:session_root_tab` — added by 372ecc97c (sase-1bc.4, %tab directive); also recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic sase-1bc.

Fix: review each call site's marker-path handling (the audit exists so new sites are consciously reviewed) and add them to the reviewed allowlist, or change the site if the review finds a real problem. Not caused by sase-1bn (node rail), whose commits touch neither file.

issue.creation_reason: The marker-path audit test is red on master because two new call sites from sase-1b2.13 and sase-1bc.4 were never reviewed into the allowlist; found during the sase-1bn landing triage.
